summary: Analysed the ten seeds of E1.

findings.text: The products raise the held-out AUROC by 0.04 on split B.
findings.heading: Products and the held-out AUROC

passages.heading: Seeds and splits
passages.text: Each configuration ran on ten seeds, $s \in \{0, \dots, 9\}$, against split B.

passages.heading: What the AUROC gain means
passages.text: The gain holds only on split B, so it is a narrower claim than C1.
